scope: all published verdicts of this generation not committed in a previous batch
sampling_rule: score = sha256("SL-SAMPLE-v1|" + beacon + "|" + commitment_hash) over the deduplicated UNION of commitment hashes from all chained batches published before the announced cutoff; select exactly K = min(100, N_total) smallest scores (hex ascending). A cumulative manifest (every batch, its file hash, per-batch and total counts, and the hash of the final union) is published before the beacon is read.
reveal_protocol: Order is mandatory: (1) commitments published while outcomes are unknown; (2) at season close, the full-population outcome file is computed, frozen and its SHA-256 published BEFORE any beacon is read; (3) the public beacon is read; (4) payload, salt and outcome are revealed only for the sampled entries. The full verdict set is never disclosed. Payloads contain only the binary verdict and public identifiers — never model internals.
